activity_summary: Setting off home by Cheapside, out of the churchyard, you said that in June it was a chronicle and in November it is a pamphlet, and that you wrote it in between and never moved. You did not say the number of leaves.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke, and stopped before the number.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Mentioned in I wrote it in between

facets.activity: Said June was a chronicle and November a pamphlet

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: In June it was a chronicle. In November it's a pamphlet. I wrote it in between and never moved.
